notes.title: Check out the Updated Steam Demo of Nitro Nation VR!
notes.content:
The updated Nitro Nation VR demo is now available! 

We've added a version from our multiplayer playtest as a public demo so you can play it anytime you want, and we've also made some improvements based on your feedback, thank you for that!

[b]What's new in the demo:[/b]

🏜️ Conquer the Mirage of Rage desert track
☔ Feel the rain on Velocity Bay city track
🔧 Use the Air Compressor for tire pressure control
🏎️ Meet a new car in the revamped garage
📈 Enjoy race progression
🏁 Defeat your friends in multiplayer races

Play the updated demo and hit the tracks in style!

[i]To install, simply click the "Download Nitro Nation VR demo" on the Steam page:[/i]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1822540

[img]https://i.imgur.com/9ozhE0A.gif[/img]

notes.title: Multiplayer Playtest is Around the Corner!
notes.content:
Get ready to rev your engines! 

We're excited to announce that a Nitro Nation VR playtest is on the horizon, and we'd love for you to be a part of it. As a playtester, you'll have the chance to get a sneak peek at the game and provide valuable feedback to the development team.

[b]To join the playtest, simply hop on our [url=https://discord.gg/v8RybDxsuV]Discord[/url] server, where we'll be sharing more details about the playtest, including dates and times. [/b]

Here are some of our planned features:
🔹Race head-to-head in 1v1 PvP and Career modes on real licensed cars.
🔹Customize the visual appearance and upgrade your car in the garage using your own hands in VR.
🔹Enjoy a highly detailed driver's cabin with immersive controls that make you feel like you are actually behind the wheel.

Since we plan to test the multiplayer feature, it's crucial to gather as many racing enthusiasts as possible before the playtest begins, so that you will have plenty of rivals to compete against on the track when the time comes.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/0TtVOkH.gif[/img]

See you on the starting line! 🏆

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1822540/Nitro_Nation_VR/

notes.title: Steam Racing Fest 2022
notes.content:
Hello, fellow racers!

We are glad to announce an update, as we are now participating in Steam Racing Fest 2022.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41589097/7a4900cb67ab9473943b9fb87d7c5d425c7c86a4.gif[/img]

Here are a few new things that you can try out since the last update in February 2022:
[list]
[*] There's now a functional gearbox for switching gears
[*] Automatic gas is now manual, use the right trigger button on your controller
[/list]
We also want to remind you that [b]we have our own re-centering system[/b] and [b]you can easily re-center with the left stick push[/b] while in-game.

We are continuing to work hard on many new things that will come in the future.

We would love to hear from you what you think about the new features listed above and the game overall. 

Put the pedal to the metal and see you on the track, racers!

notes.title: Thank You for Your Feedback!
notes.content:
Hello, racers!👋

We wanted to say thank you to everyone for taking the time to try out our demo. Currently, a little more than 1000 players have played the NNVR demo; we got more than 100 suggestions/ideas on every aspect of the functionality; around 15 videos from influencers.🚀

We're now processing the feedback and preparing for the next development phase. There's a lot to prototype, test, and check with the community. Hope to start posting new stuff here soon, so stay tuned!

See you soon! 🏎

notes.title: Nitro Nation VR Pre-Alpha Demo Release!
notes.content:
Hello, everyone!👋

Finally, you can check out the pre-alpha demo through Steam Next Festival. It includes a short ~30 minute single-player campaign as well as a garage with some basic functionality (upgrades, mini games).

[previewyoutube=HBk6WZdk9KY;full][/previewyoutube]

Your feedback on the demo would mean a lot to us! How does the driving feel, what would you want to see added, your likes/dislikes about the mechanics, any technical issues you encountered, and more.

Please feel free to share your feedback through [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1822540/discussions/] Steam Discussions [/url] and we’ll gladly respond!😊
